Alternatively a truncated final PadN (`optlen` exceeding remaining bytes) drives the scan loop past the buffer end. Both callers (`ipv6_parse_hopopts` 1039, `ipv6_destopt_rcv` 308) are remotely reachable on any IPv6 packet.

**Secondary — `ipv6_find_tlv()` (net/ipv6/exthdrs_core.c):** line 146 `optlen = nh[offset + 1] + 2;` runs when `len == 1` — size byte read one past the TLV area before the `optlen > len` check (147).
